fields.statement: How should runs' agent sessions be kept from writing .rhiza/log outside rhiza? rhiza already writes entries via temp file + rename (internal/store/store.go:358, chmod 0644), and every session already has a PreToolUse hook (rhiza session hook). / Where should a broken log entry (not canonical, or id not matching its file name, or a committed entry changed) be refused before commit? Every run commit step (build/review/ship-change render steps, plan gate 'Render the plan', ship land, ship rebase) runs rhiza render first, and render already reads the whole log but ignores its problems. / What should the repair of a damaged entry be?
